text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: I see you were talking to your support umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Every single encounter is a precious experience. 
Please make the most of them when training your 
umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally... this academy is very extensive. It's not 
unlikely you could run into umamusume not part of 
your support group～
